native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the unlocked stone carrying the smallest owed sum (repeated select-min over the candidate set).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (directed, non-negative per-edge relaxation).
A locked letter is never rebuilt again, and threads reaching nowhere are dropped (settle-once finality; unreachable stones keep unreadable/infinite debt).
core_technique: Dijkstra SSSP over directed CSR using a compacted tentative-distance frontier array with SIMD (AVX2/AVX-512) linear argmin extract-min, position back-index for decrease-key, and a lazy binary-heap Dijkstra fallback once a work budget is exceeded — i.e. the textbook array-scan/heap Dijkstra pair with generic vectorisation.
